description: This file defines a React functional component named RetroNode, which renders a customizable diagram node with inline editing capabilities. It manages state for editing mode and label drafts, dynamically sets header labels based on node type, and handles label change and deletion actions through passed-in callbacks. The component also includes styling and accessibility attributes for interactive diagram nodes.

methods.name: RetroNode({ id, data, selected })
methods.description: React component for rendering a diagram node with inline editing, dynamic label header, and delete functionality.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Saves the current draft label if valid, then exits editing mode, calling onChangeLabel callback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels editing and resets the draft label to the initial label, then exits editing mode.
